title: 浅拷贝 vs 深拷贝：嵌套对象是否共享
expected_output:
after shallow, a: [1, [2, 3, 99], 4]
after deep, a: [1, [2, 3, 99], 4]
code:
import copy
a = [1, [2, 3], 4]
b = copy.copy(a)          # 浅拷贝：外层新列表，内层共享
b[1].append(99)
print("after shallow, a:", a)
b2 = copy.deepcopy(a)     # 深拷贝：内层也独立
b2[1].append(100)
print("after deep, a:", a)
